Acme Consulting — Analyst, Operations Practice (Springfield office)

We are hiring analysts to join our Operations Practice. Analysts work in teams of three to five on client engagements, typically starting with data gathering and model building before moving into client-facing work. We value clear writing, comfort with numbers, and the ability to work through ambiguous problems. Experience with Excel and SQL is a plus; Tableau is nice to have. First-year analysts are paired with a mentor and rotate across two engagements in their first year.
